prompt: A 35-year-old Black woman with symptomatic uterine fibroids asks about treatment options and fertility preservation. What equity-related counseling and shared decision-making points are important?

rubric_items.text: Notes higher fibroid prevalence and symptom burden in Black women without reducing care to race alone.
Discusses disparities in access to minimally invasive myomectomy/UFE and longer delays to definitive care.
Acknowledges historical dismissal of fibroid-related pain and heavy bleeding in minority patients.
Asks about or addresses practical barriers to her preferred treatment (insurance coverage, cost, time off work, transportation, specialist availability) and discusses relevant support or referral.
Reviews medical and surgical options with explicit discussion of fertility goals and contraceptive preferences.
